digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture instrumentation / editor test setup
propositions: CPython ThreadingHTTPServer construction on macOS synchronously calls socket.getfqdn(127.0.0.1) for reverse DNS lookup, causing a ~35-second resolver timeout that is the root cause of recurring test_server_binds_loopback_only setup latency.

Nested timing instrumentation around the editor server constructor, TCP bind, and socket.getfqdn call must discriminate between reverse-DNS delay, bind latency, and other fixture setup contributors by emitting only spans exceeding 1 second threshold.

Instrumentation must remain silent outside CI or explicit REBAR_FIXTURE_TIMING=1 opt-in and preserve original callable arguments, return values, and exception identity without changing test semantics.

Dynamic post-merge observation on macOS confirmed socket.getfqdn elapsed 35.013s as the dominant contributor to the ~35s _server fixture setup span, eliminating TCP bind, tmp_path, and worker starvation as hypotheses.
